payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iteratively constructs k-th lexicographically smallest substring by counting substrings with each prefix and pruning character branches where cumulative count < k.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a branch-and-bound approach: it maintains counts of substrings starting with each possible next character, prunes entire character branches when their total count is less than k, and narrows the search to survived positions iteratively.
